dedupe_keys.name: tuflow hydraulic and hydrodynamic modelling suite classic hpc fv

description: TUFLOW, from BMT, produced a commercial hydraulic and hydrodynamic modelling suite for flood, urban stormwater, lake, estuarine and coastal studies. It has two 2D grid solvers (Classic, an implicit ADI scheme, and HPC, GPU accelerated with quadtree meshes and sub-grid sampling) dynamically linked to the 1D solver ESTRY, and a 2D/3D flexible mesh solver (TUFLOW FV) with add-ons for sediment, water quality and particle tracking. Coverage is any catchment or coast, and the solvers are used mainly for catchment, flood and urban drainage modelling. The software is paid under licence, while the engines, manuals and tutorial models are a free download that runs licence-free for learning. Caveats: it is proprietary, and the speed-up of 10 to 400 times on GPU is the vendor's own figure. Simulation uses: flood inundation, drainage capacity and dam break studies. Related records: HEC-RAS (model-hec-ras), LISFLOOD-FP (model-lisflood-fp) and ANUGA (model-anuga).
inputs: Terrain, 1D channel and pipe networks, boundary flows and rainfall, prepared in GIS or GUI environments
name: TUFLOW hydraulic and hydrodynamic modelling suite (Classic, HPC, FV)
outputs: 1D and 2D (and in FV 3D) water levels, depths and velocities for catchment, flood and urban drainage models; add-on sediment and water quality results
